subject: general
question: Who is NOT a Goldman Environmental Prize (Green Nobel Prize) winner?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vandana Shiva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Vandana Shiva** is a renowned environmental activist, author, and food sovereignty advocate from India.
 
• She is known for her opposition to corporate-led globalization and her work in promoting organic farming and biodiversity.
 
• Despite her significant contributions to environmental activism, **she has not been awarded the Goldman Environmental Prize.**
 
• The Goldman Environmental Prize, also known as the "Green Nobel Prize," honors grassroots environmental activists, and while Shiva has received numerous accolades, this is not one of them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Goldman Environmental Prize:**

 
 
• Often referred to as the "Green Nobel Prize," it was established in 1989 by philanthropists Richard and Rhoda Goldman.
 
• The prize is awarded annually to grassroots environmental activists from six continental regions: Africa, Asia, Europe, Islands and Island Nations, North America, and South and Central America.
 
• It recognizes individuals who have made significant efforts to protect and enhance the natural environment, often at great personal risk.
 
• Winners receive a monetary prize and international recognition for their environmental work.
 
 
 
• **Ramesh Agrawal:**
 
 
• Ramesh Agrawal, an Indian environmental activist, won the Goldman Environmental Prize in 2014.
 
• He was recognized for his efforts in helping villagers fight against coal mining in Chhattisgarh, India.
 
• His activism led to the cancellation of several coal mining projects, protecting the environment and the health of local communities.
 
 
 
• **Champa Devi Shukla:**
 
 
• Champa Devi Shukla is an Indian activist who, along with Rashida Bee, won the Goldman Environmental Prize in 2004.
 
• She was honored for her work in seeking justice for the victims of the 1984 Bhopal gas tragedy.
 
• Her efforts have focused on holding corporations accountable and advocating for environmental justice.
 
 
 
• **Medha Patkar:**
 
 
• Medha Patkar is a prominent Indian social activist known for her role in the Narmada Bachao Andolan (Save Narmada Movement).
 
• She has been a leading voice against large dam projects on the Narmada River, highlighting their environmental and social impacts.
 
• While she has received numerous awards for her activism, she has not been a recipient of the Goldman Environmental Prize.
